findings.observed: The turquoise line joins both ends of the semicircle diameter and is labeled r. The upper arc is labeled s and the heading states half-turn arc length pi*r. In adjacent v6-26.B01 the r segment correctly runs center to circumference.
findings.reason: The visual calls a diameter a radius at the point that defines radian conversion, so the stated pi*r arc relationship is visually inconsistent.
findings.recommendedChange: Use a center-to-edge r radius (preferred continuity with B01), optionally show a center point. Alternatively label the full diameter 2r while retaining a radius definition.
